data.explanation: This is a delivery notice from a furniture company, not a bill or official letter. On the appointment day, keep the spot where the wardrobe will stand clear and make sure a vehicle can park near the house. If 12 December does not work for you, call the company at least three working days beforehand to reschedule. Attending the information evening on 17 December is optional and needs no registration, so there is nothing to sign up for.
